title: NLTK: ARFF_Formatter Injects Weka ARFF Schema Directives via Attacker-Controlled Class Labels (CVE-2026-129221)
description: NLTK's ARFF_Formatter component improperly handles class labels when generating Weka ARFF files, allowing attacker-controlled labels to inject arbitrary ARFF schema directives. This occurs because class labels are embedded without escaping, enabling injection of ARFF metacharacters that can alter the ARFF file structure. The vulnerability affects any application using WekaClassifier.train() or ARFF_Formatter.from_train() with untrusted training data. A fix has been merged but not yet released as of the latest information.
